title: IEEE 754 Converter
description: Convert between decimal and 32-bit IEEE 754 float bits, with the sign, exponent and mantissa broken down.
howto: Press Convert to see the 32 bits and each field explained.

faqs.q: Why does 0.1 not convert back exactly?
faqs.a: 0.1 has no exact binary fraction, so the 32-bit float stores the nearest value: 0.10000000149…
1 sign bit, 8 exponent bits (biased by 127), and 23 mantissa bits holding the fraction after the leading 1.
Exponent 255 is special: zero mantissa means ±Infinity, nonzero mantissa means NaN.
